data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis #5, fixture side): the single '# OMITTED-SITE' marker MUST be on a genuine legacy_call call line, and NO other legacy_call line may contain the substring 'OMITTED-SITE' (so task-2's sweep grep-protect does not over-preserve).
